reading_notes: Source is a single photographed rate card (not a structured questionnaire response), so none of the RFQ questionnaire items (ISO, burst-strength certs, FSC, lead time, capacity headroom) are directly addressed anywhere in the document; all left null. A payment note 'PAYMENT 30 DAYS' appears near the bottom but is a general term statement, not a direct yes/no answer to the RFQ's '45-day payment terms accepted' question, and conflicts with the RFQ's 45-day basis — flagged as evidence only, not treated as an answer. Pricing basis differs from the RFQ throughout: 3-ply items (PKG-001 to PKG-012) are quoted 'RATE PER 100 PCS' and 5-ply/7-ply items (PKG-013 to PKG-030) are quoted 'RATE PER CASE', neither of which is 'per piece' as the RFQ basis requires; all amounts are reported as-quoted with no conversion performed. The note giving standard case-pack quantity ('STD CASE PACK = ___ PCS') has its numeric value blurred/obscured in the image, so a per-piece rate cannot be derived for any 5-ply/7-ply line — flagged case_pack_qty_illegible on those 18 lines. PKG-022's price cell is faded/blurred and not reliably legible; reported as null with needs_review. Header states 'FOR BHIWANDI, GST EXTRA' as a blanket condition on all prices; whether 'FOR' implies freight-inclusive delivered pricing to Bhiwandi DC (as the RFQ basis requests) or ex-works pricing is not clarified in the document and is reported verbatim rather than interpreted. Printed items (PKG-006, PKG-013, PKG-023) are marked 'PRINTED' but no print-color count is stated, whereas the RFQ specifies 1-col or 2-col for these lines.
